channel.title: Age: 13+ on More Than Games
channel.description: Recent content in Age: 13+ on More Than Games

item.title: Review: Starfinder 2nd Edition Playtest Rulebook (Paizo)
item.description: Seven years after its successful launch, the Starfinder Roleplaying Game is headed for a second edition — and Paizo wants everyone to get a voice in its creation. 13+, 3-7 players, 3-4 hours

item.title: Review: The Rich and the Good (Ares Games)
item.description: In The Rich and the Good from Ares Games, you’re a commodities trader in the midst of the Second Industrial Revolution. 13+, 2-5 players, 45-60 minutes

item.title: Review: Starfinder Galaxy Exploration Manual (Paizo)
item.description: The world is a big place to explore, but it’s not much compared to a whole universe. 13+, 4-7 players, 1-4 hours to set up, 4-6 hours to play

item.title: Review: Pathfinder Beginner Box (Paizo)
item.description: Starting any hobby can feel daunting. 13+, 2-5 players, 60 minutes

item.title: Review: Volcanic Isle (Arcane Wonders)
item.description: Let’s start with the basics: In Volcanic Isle from Arcane Wonders, the island you’re on will sink. 13+, 2-4 players, 5 to set up, 45-60 minutes to play

item.title: Review: Starfinder Beginner Box Review
item.description: Trying to make a useful “beginner” version of anything takes some guts, especially if the topic at hand is more complex than explaining Dots and Boxes or successfully walking your dog. 13+, 2-7 players, 5-30 to set up, 30-60 minutes to play

item.title: Review: Islebound (Red Raven)
item.description: Hop aboard your trusty ship to find adventure and fame in Islebound, the latest title from Red Raven Games. 13+, 2-4 players, 5 to set up, 90 to play
